name: Hushed, Boop says nothing for a while, and sulks a little
case: Nothing is working. The person tells Boop to be quiet: it replies hush, a medium moment, so half an hour, and its mood takes one small step down (tired or uneasy), never a jump. For the next half hour it still makes faces at a poke and at a finished turn, but says nothing at all. Once the half hour is up, a poke gets something said again. Later the app's Hush button hushes it again, and it sulks a step; then the person says it can talk now, its reply lets it talk, and a poke gets something said again.
why: ReactOutput: a hush reply hushes it for as long as the moment is big (Core.hushMsBySize), and while hushed `say` isn't asked and nothing is said; unhush is offered only while hushed; PERSONALITY: hushed, it sulks a little, its mood one ordinary step down

steps.words: shh, be quiet for a bit
okay okay, you can talk now
